newsitem.title: USA: Alameda County, Calif, board adopts coliseum plan.
newsitem.headline: Alameda County, Calif, board adopts coliseum plan.

text.p: The Board of Supervisors of Alameda County, Calif., on Tuesday approved a plan that was expected to give local elected officials more control over the Oakland Coliseum's fiscal operations.
After the vote, county officials said the changes were needed, though one supervisor, Gail Steele, said that the "reorganization isn't in itself going to solve the problems.
As reported earlier, the Oakland-Alameda County Coliseum Board, which has operated the sports complex for more than 30 years, voted to dissolve itself.
